Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. items.summary: Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). items.summary: A deployable text-to-image diffusion model must hold several capabilities at once, such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and must sample in a few steps. Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages: a full-step model first consolidates capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, then serves as a fixed teacher for step distillation. items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. items.summary: Embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations, but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information, such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. items.summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. items.summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved. items.summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. items.summary: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. items.summary: For a decade, progress in artificial intelligence has been measured by how much a machine can do on its own. items.summary: Chunk-interleaved full-duplex speech language models listen and speak in fixed time chunks, and each chunk must be processed before the next one arrives. items.summary: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. items.title: 办了33年的ACM MM，重新划定研究范围

items.title: 上交大张伟楠教授：AI如何走出屏幕，真正改变物理世界？ | CNCC 2026
items.summary: 物理智能的核心挑战：让 AI 在充满不确定性、行动后果难以撤销的真实世界中，形成感知、预测、行动与持续学习的完整闭环。 作者丨张 驰 编辑丨马晓宁 大语言模型已经得到了长足的发展，但 AI 的许多能力仍然发生在屏幕之内：理解文字、生成内容、编写代码，以及调用数字工具。把这些能力带入工厂、实验室和城市设施，意味着智能系统必须进一步面对物体、空间、力与时间，在持续变化的环境中作出判断，并承担行动的实际后果。 AI 如何从处理数字信息走向可靠地参与物理过程，正是 “ 物 理智能 ” 要回答的问题。 这一步跨越的难度，很难仅用模型参数或推理能力来衡量。机器人拿起一只杯子，既要识别位置和形状，也要判断接触、摩擦与受力；实验设备执行一次操作，既要理解任务，还要满足精度、时延和安全约束。 网页操作失误可以刷新，物理世界中的碰撞、损坏却未必能够撤销。感知是否及时、动作是否可控、失败后能否恢复，都会直接影响系统能否真正投入使用。 在今年 CNCC 首日面向博士生、青年学者的 Tutorial 专题论坛环节中， 上海交通大学计算机学院教授、上海人工智能实验室物理智能中心负责人张伟楠 发表了题为《物理智能及关键技术概述》的演讲。在他看来，基础模型、世界模型、强化学习与高吞吐仿真、虚实迁移，以及硬件成本的下降，正在共同推动物理智能从研究愿景走向可行实践。与此同时，真实交互数据昂贵、环境只能被局部观测、长时…

items.title: 原来达里奥切除过睾丸，很少有人知道
items.summary: Anthropic 的达里曾经得过睾丸癌。2014 年，他确诊后接受化疗，最终完全康复。这段经历此前鲜为人知。 《纽约时报》 2026 年 11 月 5 日左右的深度报道（ Ryan Mac 等）首次较详细公开了这件事。报道称，两名认识他的人透露，Dario Amodei 在 2014 年被诊断出睾丸癌，当时他在斯坦福做癌症细胞相关博士后研究。他接受了化疗，最终完全康复。 ------------- 早期睾丸癌（主要指 I 期）治疗标准第一步切除一侧睾丸。治愈率超过 95%。剩下一侧通常能维持生育和睾酮。多数人仍可自然生育。 化疗：常导致暂时不育。多数人 1-2 年后恢复精子生成，5 年时约 80%恢复。少数永久受损。 RPLND：可能损伤射精神经，导致逆行射精（精液进膀胱）。
